The paper has several serious weaknesses. Third, the methodological contribution is minimal—it is a straightforward application of off-the-shelf models. These weaknesses are severe and undermine the core empirical claims of the paper. The purported results are not credible, and the scientific contribution is essentially zero. This warrants a score at the very low end of the scale.
